title: Herbster Wisconsin Anagama Wood Fire Workshop
pay_text: Workshop fee $750, $100 non-refundable deposit to register
how_to_join: Send deposit to Mike Weber, PO BOX 45, Herbster, WI 54844, or contact weberml@uwec.edu or 715-774-3707
bring: bisqued or formed pots (participants create work during workshop)
summary: A 16-day anagama wood-firing workshop for up to 12 participants each summer in northern Wisconsin. Participants create work over three days, then participate in loading, firing (24-hour stoking over three days), and unloading of the 24-foot-long kiln.
evidence_sentence: The workshop page states participants join a 16-day workshop teaching the process of firing a traditional Anagama kiln, with stoking shifts during a four-day firing.
evidence_quote: Stoking of the fire takes place 24 hours a day for three days, and consists of three eight-hour shifts.
